dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Now, the ending. How are you going to finish?
dialogue.reading: ˈnaʊ, ði ˈɛndɪŋ. ˈhaʊ ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈfɪnɪʃ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'll say, "In conclusion, Thai students want to use English more."
dialogue.reading: aɪl ˈseɪ, ɪn kənˈkluːʒən, ˈtaɪ ˈstuːdənts ˈwɑːnt tə ˈjuːz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈmɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's a good main idea, but it's a bit short. Can you give a summary of your results first?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈɡʊd ˈmeɪn aɪˈdiːə, bʌt ɪts ə ˈbɪt ˈʃɔːrt. kən juː ˈɡɪv ə ˈsʌməri əv jʊr rɪˈzʌlts ˈfɜːrst?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. "To sum up, most students use English online, but only a few speak it every day."
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. tə ˈsʌm ˈʌp, ˈmoʊst ˈstuːdənts ˈjuːz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˌɑːnˈlaɪn, bʌt ˈoʊnli ə ˈfjuː ˈspiːk ɪt ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Better. And what does that mean overall?
dialogue.reading: ˈbɛtər. ənd ˈwʌt dʌz ðæt ˈmiːn ˌoʊvərˈɔːl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: "Overall, students have lots of chances to read English, but very few chances to speak it."
dialogue.reading: ˌoʊvərˈɔːl, ˈstuːdənts ˈhæv ˈlɑːts əv ˈtʃænsɪz tə ˈriːd ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ, bʌt ˈvɛri ˈfjuː ˈtʃænsɪz tə ˈspiːk ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Very clear. Do you have any recommendations?
dialogue.reading: ˈvɛri ˈklɪr. duː juː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˌrɛkəmɛnˈdeɪʃənz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, two. My first recommendation is more speaking activities in class.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈtuː. maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˌrɛkəmɛnˈdeɪʃən ɪz ˈmɔːr ˈspiːkɪŋ ækˈtɪvətiz ɪn ˈklæs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Universities should start language exchanges with foreign students.
dialogue.reading: ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsətiz ʃʊd ˈstɑːrt ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ɪksˌtʃeɪndʒɪz wɪð ˈfɔːrən ˈstuːdənts.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great. After your recommendations, thank the audience and ask for questions.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ˈæftər jʊr ˌrɛkəmɛnˈdeɪʃənz, ˈθæŋk ði ˈɔːdiəns ənd ˈæsk fər ˈkwɛstʃənz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Got it. "Thank you for listening. Are there any questions?"
dialogue.reading: ˈɡɑːt ɪt. ˈθæŋk juː fər ˈlɪsənɪŋ. ər ðɛr ˈɛni ˈkwɛstʃənz?
